thread:
Natalia (CloudWave): Hey team — CloudWave is ready to onboard eu-central private region for Redwood Private. We need reserved capacity for A100-80GB x8 and 2x P4d for burst, plus marketplace listing enabled. Target go-live 2026-05-15. Any blockers?

Alex R.: Thanks — couple quick checks: can you confirm expected p95/p99 SLOs and monthly committed GPU hours? Also confirm provider (AWS/GCP).

Natalia (CloudWave): SLOs match our other regions: p95 100ms for text gen, p99 will be softer but acceptable. Monthly commit = 720 GPU-hours baseline, burst up to ~2000. Provider = AWS (eu-central-1).

Maria P.: Got it. I'll start partner PO/entitlement flow. Need partner account ID + billing contact email.

Natalia (CloudWave): Partner account ID: cw-98765. Billing contact: partner-billing@cloudwave.com.

Sanjay K.: From infra side: since this is in eu-central we'll need marketplace entitlements + EC2 quota bump for GPU instance types. Also confirm whether Dedicated Hosts or normal instances.

Natalia (CloudWave): We'll use Dedicated Hosts for isolation.

Liam T.: OK. We'll need ENI and EC2 GPU quotas increased. I'll open an infra ticket and attach a TF snippet for service quota request. @PartnerOps Bot — can you drop the quota playbook?

PartnerOps Bot: Playbook link: https://internal.redwood/ops/playbooks/marketplace-entitlement — includes checklist: partner metadata, pricing SKUs, KMS policy, quota request examples.

Alex R.: Action items: Liam open infra ticket + partner marketplace onboarding ticket. Maria coordinate legal for DPA/addendum. Jesse (Legal) FYI.

Legal (Jesse): Quick read: we'll need a DPA amendment and KMS key pushdown language. Can draft an addendum by EOD Friday if no unusual items.

Liam T.: Infra ticket created: INC-20260321-84. Requests: EC2 A100 quota, ENI, increase for G4/P4 families, Dedicated Host allocation. Adding TF example for quota request:
```hcl
resource "aws_servicequotas_service_quota" "gpu_quota" {
  service_code = "ec2"
  quota_name   = "Running On-Demand GPGPU instances"
  value        = 16
}
```

Maria P.: Partner entitlement created in portal, status = pending provider approval. Need legal signoff + AWS marketplace listing metadata (logo, pricing model). Natalia, please provide pricing SKUs and logo.

Natalia (CloudWave): Pricing SKUs: reserved-monthly = cw-redwood-1, on-demand-burst = cw-redwood-burst. Logo: https://cloudwave.com/assets/logo-redwood.png.

Sanjay K.: Tech note: model shard storage will be on EBS gp3 encrypted with customer KMS. Need either partner-provided KMS ARN or Redwood-managed key consent. Which do you prefer?

Natalia (CloudWave): We'll provide KMS ARN by next Tuesday.

Alex R.: Timeline recap: infra ticket open, legal to draft addendum by EOD Fri, marketplace approval ~5-7 business days after submit. If KMS by Tue we should be on track for 2026-05-15. Please react with :thumbsup: if this works.

Maria P.: :thumbsup:

Liam T.: :thumbsup:

Natalia (CloudWave): Thanks everyone — I'll push the KMS ARN and final SLA doc today.

Alex R.: Great — I'll keep the partner onboarding thread updated with ticket links and milestone checkins.
